```{r, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=6.5}

# WL_seu$annotation SMCs -> SMC
anno_colors <- list(
  annotation = c(
    "Alveolar" = "#3CA5D1",
    "Adventitial" = "#8D8DC3",
    "Inflammatory" = "#EF9F80",
    "SMC" = "#D28088",
    "CTHRC1+" = "#FF5919",
    "Peribronchial" = "#58A456"

  ),
  Condition = c(
    "Aged control" = "#717e8d",

  )
)

fibroblast_markers_list <- c(
    "NPNT", "CES1", "WNT2", "TCF21", "INMT", "FIBIN",
  "MFAP5", "SCARA5", "PTGIS", "IGFBP6", "SFRP2", "PI16",
  "AOC3", "GPM6B", "SCN7A", "FMO2", "CYP4B1", "LIMCH1",
  "FGFR4", "ITGA8", "RARRES2", "GPC3",
  "CCL2", "CXCL12", "HAS2", "PTGDS",
  "MYH11", "ACTA2", "LMOD1", "MYL9",
  "CTHRC1", "TGFB1", "POSTN", "COL10A1",
  "WIF1", "FGF18", "ASPN"
)

colors <- c("#53b1dc", "#FFFFFF", "#EE6677")
scHeatmap(WL_seu, features = fibroblast_markers_list, 
          group.by = c("annotation", "Condition"),
          anno_colors = anno_colors, width = 5.5, height = 6.5, colors = colors,
                    save_path = file.path(save.path, "marker_genes_annotation_Condition_heatmap.pdf")
)

```


## Supplementary Fig. 1c
```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=3, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggpubr)
my_comparisons <- list(
  c("Aged control", "IPF upper lobe"),
  c("Aged control", "IPF lower lobe")
)

cthrc1 <- subset(WL_seu, subset = annotation == "CTHRC1+")

p <- VlnPlot(
  cthrc1,
  features = "CTHRC1",
  group.by = "Condition",
  cols = anno_colors$Condition,
  combine = FALSE
)[[1]] +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = my_comparisons,
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    size = 6,
    vjust = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15)))

print(p)
ggsave(file.path(save.path, "CTHRC1_violin_Condition.pdf"), p, width = 5,height = 3)


p <- VlnPlot(
  cthrc1,
  features = "COL1A1",
  group.by = "Condition",
  cols = anno_colors$Condition,
  combine = FALSE
)[[1]] +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = my_comparisons,
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    size = 6,
    vjust = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15)))

print(p)
ggsave(file.path(save.path, "COL1A1_violin_Condition.pdf"), p, width = 5,height = 3)


```

## Supplementary Fig. 1d
```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=3, message=FALSE}
plot_vln <- function(seu, condition, feature, comparisons = NULL) {
  p <- VlnPlot(
    subset(seu, subset = Condition == condition),
    features = feature,
    group.by = "annotation",
    cols = anno_colors$annotation,
    combine = FALSE
  )[[1]] +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 8)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.25)))
  
  if (!is.null(comparisons)) {
    p <- p + stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = comparisons,
      method = "wilcox.test",
      label = "p.signif",
      size = 6,
      vjust = 0.5
    )
  }
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(save.path, paste0(feature, "_violin_", gsub(" ", "_", condition), ".pdf")),
    p,
    width = 5,
    height = 3
  )
  
  p
}

my_comparisons <- list(
  c("Alveolar", "CTHRC1+"),
  c("SMC", "CTHRC1+")
)

p1 <- plot_vln(WL_seu, "Aged control", "COL1A1", my_comparisons)
p1
p2 <- plot_vln(WL_seu, "IPF upper lobe", "COL1A1", my_comparisons)
p2
p3 <- plot_vln(WL_seu, "IPF lower lobe", "COL1A1", my_comparisons)
p3
```
